reference.pathophysiology: Synovial autoimmunity pannus erodes cartilage and bone in symmetric small joints; anti-CCP marks erosive disease, nodules and vasculitis complicate, and atlantoaxial instability threatens the cord while amyloid and Felty cytopenias complicate late.
additionalDifferentials: Psoriatic versus lupus versus gout versus septic by DIP dactylitis Jaccoud tophi and cultures
Erosive versus Jaccoud versus haemochromatosis by X-ray pattern
Atlantoaxial versus cervical spondylosis by instability films and neurology
additionalInvestigations: Anti-CCP with rheumatoid factor CRP ESR
Neck films with eye and lung screens
